title: Null Zone
description: An area where nothing exists — no sound, no light, no sensation. Your footsteps make no noise, your breath produces no warmth, and your shadow simply stops at the boundary. The absence is so complete it becomes a presence of its own, pressing against your mind like the weight of an empty universe.

choices.label: Gather null fragments
choices.description: Collect the solidified pieces of nothingness that crumble away from the zone's edges.

outcomes.text: The fragments feel like holding frozen silence. They weigh nothing and everything at once. Your collection vessel fills quickly at the zone's crumbling edge.
You gather a handful, but one fragment collapses inward and creates a brief vacuum that pulls at your lungs. You stagger back gasping.

The null zone surges outward as you disturb its edge. For a terrifying moment, everyone ceases to exist — then reality snaps back, leaving you shaken and numb. A single null fragment remains in your clenched fist.

choices.label: Meditate in the void
choices.description: Sit within the absolute silence and let the absence wash away pain and exhaustion.

outcomes.text: In the silence, pain has no meaning. Wounds forget they exist. You emerge feeling restored in ways medicine cannot explain.
The meditation soothes your bodies, but the void leaves an unsettling emptiness in your thoughts. Something was taken along with the pain.
The nothingness reaches too deep. One hero snaps awake screaming, unable to remember their own name for several terrible seconds.

choices.label: Retreat
choices.description: The nothingness is crawling into your thoughts. Time to leave.

outcomes.text: You back away from the boundary. Sound and sensation return like a wave breaking, and you breathe in the chaos of existence with gratitude.
